narrative:
Miami County has 77,636 registered voters, with 54.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 35.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 10.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 24.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.9% of registrants.
